sections.overview: Miomantis binotata is an African praying mantis described by Giglio-Tos in 1911.
sections.identification: The consulted references do not provide a reliable species-specific field description or measurements.
sections.habitat: Published records list it from several African countries, including Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tanzania and Togo.
sections.diet: The sources consulted do not document its prey or feeding in detail.
sections.behavior: Detailed behavior specific to this species was not described in the sources consulted.
sections.reproduction: The available species accounts do not describe its reproduction.
sections.ecology: The updated South African museum checklist treats its distribution from earlier literature and does not report a South African occurrence for this species.
sections.conservation: No species-level global assessment was located.
